story: A ledger (the instrument) kept accounts of sure promotion and Number One and withheld permission to open, five times; a leaf turned toward it and opened anyway. A man gave goats' cheese, all he had, on one platter; the ledger struck 'deserved' because he never asked, and had to list the crumb (0.4 g) above everything. His head was already inclining before the first voice knew what to say. In XIV the cut edge became a platter with a raised lip and the receiving sheet learned to hold a little weight. In XVI everything came attached: fruiting organ, flesh and seed given together, one act of transfer, no separate verdicts. 'Because he has it.' DESERVED remains struck. The prescribed route is redrawn as a coast with four stations; soundings dropped beside it find no bottom, and the bearing the instrument records is the angle of the inclining head.

voices.first: the instrument: bureaucratic, keeps registers and permits, ranks (№1 №2 №3), checks boxes, writes maxims in caps (TAKE CARE OF NUMBER ONE), withholds permission unless improvement is promised; ink on vellum or umber on black
voices.second: 2nd hand: cobalt, terse, plain, a little tender; corrects the first voice in the margin ('it opened without you.', 'who writes this?', 'asked? no.'), strikes words through, asks questions the first voice cannot answer

entries.title: PROMOTION LEDGER
entries.caption: The ledger has a column for sure promotion, a column for pleasant, a column for Number One, and no column at all for a leaf that turned toward me and asked nothing. Permission withheld, five times; in the margin someone else has written that it opened anyway.
entries.beat: the instrument keeps accounts; the leaf opens without permission

entries.title: COURSE OF READING
entries.caption: Given: goats' cheese, all he had, recorded. Platter: one. Deserved: not asked, struck, a rule of dashes the route runs past on its way downhill; the crumb is listed above everything and the head is already inclining before I know what to say.
entries.beat: the gift is recorded and 'deserved' struck; the head inclines

entries.title: THE EDGE BECOMES A PLATTER
entries.beat: the plate's edge is rebuilt as a vessel with a raised lip; the receiving sheet learns to hold a little weight
flaws: labels on the right clipped by the frame

entries.title: EVERYTHING ATTACHED
entries.beat: fruit, flesh and seed given together in one act of transfer; DESERVED struck; 'Because he has it.'

entries.title: SOUNDINGS OFF THE PRESCRIBED COAST
entries.caption: The sheet records four stations along the prescribed coast, a compass, and eleven soundings dropped where nobody asked for depth; the lead came back wet every time and the register has no line for that. The one bearing it managed to fix is twelve degrees down, and in the margin someone has written that the crumb is still listed.
entries.beat: The prescribed route is redrawn as a coast with four stations; soundings dropped beside it find no bottom, and the bearing the instrument records is the angle of the inclining head.
